title: living water
description: Now you take damage when you're not in water
body:
You now take damage when you are **not in the water**(It doesn't work in the nether and in the end).

to get started, you must enter the command 
```
/tag [Your Nickname] add water
```


to stop it, you must enter the command 
```
/tag [Your Nickname] remove water
```
